content: Ahringpaw pehlainah

Macawtaco uny sahlo, Khazing a zawngenah rawng tahei, naa pung khah a pathaipaw le Khazing lung a lawngsahpaw ahringpaw athuihlainah hratah pae pawtah ka ca sia he. Ma cawh thlawpaw lang tah Khazing beh hmuisui cawh a cang.

Ma khazaw hringzia naning hei hring leimei hrah khe o, canghrasala naa thinglung pathasah nátah naa hringzia cawh a thlai thlu seh. Taico Khazing dunah a cangpaw, achawpaw le lung a lawngsahpaw le a tlingpaw a dunah cawh pase khy he ceh ka naa hni khy a.

Ka hmuhpaw Khazing ningdonah thongtah ma bia heh naa zongmingtei hai letah ka rei. Naaning le naaning khah a pasangtu khe o. Naa cangnah tukhah a hnih hri la, Khazing tah a ca pehpaw he zingnah cacy teikhei naaning le naaning a rawh my lo.
Kaa pung cung lehei pung caibai hlupui hnui he peh ka, ma a caibai vytei tahei rai cacangpaw aa hnui cy.

Ma hraco kaaning zong mehlupui kaa cang naná tah Khri kha ka peitlenah pawhe peh thongtah pungkheh cang peh ka, pung caibai cacy cawh sangkheh le sangkheh a tle thlupaw he hratah kaaning zong pakheh le pakheh ka peitle thlu peh.

Macawtaco lahsong phingcang kaa hmuhpaw cacy khah Khazing tei a ma pehpaw ningdonah cacy naning khei hmang he peh seh. Lahsong kaa hmuhpaw cawh Khazing bia phykhynah a cang caco, zingnah kaa hnuipaw hrakhei kaa hmang ruapaw a cang.
Male cawtah raihre ruapaw a cang caco, ma hraco hre he peh. Cawngpah ruapaw a cang caco, cawngpah he peh.

Male thawzaang peh rua a cang caco, thawzaang pei he peh. Kaa hnuipaw hming khah male a hrawng hrápaw a cang caco, hechia lytah a hrawngsah hrápaw he a cang. Hruitu cangnah a cang caco, teria teitah hre ruapaw a cang, male ningdo khah a cang caco, lunglawng teitah ning kaa do ruapaw he a cang.
Donah
A donah cawh lungthing hmuisui tah a cangpaw a cang. Hming chah ly khah a hua la, hming chawpaw khah a tle paria thlang my lo.
Pakheh le pakheh khah Khri letah uny hratah a do la, ming hringpaw khah nama navy tah pasungpanaw vy my lo.
Raihrenah kong letah naa thaw thi kheh seh la, Thlawpaw lang kong letah chahnai nge la, Abuipaw rai cawh hre my lo.
Naa hnabeisuinah lekhei naa thawchah seh la, hanah letah lungsy teitah ung la, thlawchangnah kong letah zingchui pawtah ung my lo.
Naa hnuipaw khah Khazing cawngsaw a phahlahpaw sahlo khah chaichy hrah my lo. Khuachai khah achaw teitah mingkhai my lo.
Naaning a ca hreh pawhe khah Khazing khatah bonghnang song la, chiasah khe lo.
A lawngpaw sahlo khakhei a lawng hrá la, a cahpaw khakhei cah hrah my lo.
Pakheh le pakheh lungrua teitah ung my lo. A palai a patui khe la, cawngsaw cakhawngpaw khatah a huikongnah hnui khah du mylo. Ming hringpaw navy tah ka singvang vy tatah a pacang khe lo.
Naa cung letah hmingchahly a tuapaw khah chah ly ná tah veri thing khe lo. Ming vytei tei a chah tatah aa rawhpaw khah tua a zawng my lo.
A cang khy caco, naaning chang tah cawngsaw maikaw kha a dorai teitah ung khah a zawng my lo.

Naa phu a hlang khe lo, uny sahlo, Khazing thingaenah cawh langtlui hri my lo. Zecawtamaw tatah Capathai letah, “Phuhlang cawh kama ka rai a cang, kama tah veri ka thing tae a,” tatah Abuipaw tah a tah.
Macawtaco Capathai tah,

content.text: “Na caraepaw cawh a ngai a di caco, batui va pei la,
a tui a hrae caco tui va pei, ma hratei na tua caco,
a lu cung letah a ae leimeipaw mehei chia hratah a cang a,”

content: a tahpaw hrakhei va tua hri my lo.
Chahlynah khah a tesah khe la, chahnah tuaná khei chahlynah te hri my lo.
